items.title: The cheapest new cars to own in America are THESE retro-styled EVs
items.summary:
A study of 50 new cars found that the compact but stylish Fiat 500e was America’s cheapest car to own and drive, beating out the Honda Civic Hybrid by nearly $1,300 per year.
And the second most affordable EV to own? It’s also from Stellantis.

items.title: To cram more AI skills onto LinkedIn profiles, more job seekers are turning to 'time travel,' say researchers

items.title: Trump plans to grow his way out of $40 trillion debt crisis—it’s a ‘fantastic story’ but virtually impossible, says top budget economist
items.summary: "If you tell the debt markets: 'Hey, we think we're gonna be able to grow our way out of this,' and then a year later they're not seeing any improvements from that, then it's a credibility issue."
items.titleZh: 特朗普计划通过增长摆脱40万亿美元的债务危机——这是一个“奇妙的故事”，但几乎不可能，首席预算经济学家说
items.summaryZh: “如果你告诉债务市场：‘嘿，我们认为我们能够通过增长摆脱困境’，然后一年后他们没有看到任何改善，那么这就是一个信誉问题。”
